given: no stock record yet exists for a given SKU at a given physical location
when: a warehouse operator files that SKU at that location with a quantity
then: a stock record for that (SKU, location) pair exists, and retrieving it returns the SKU, location, and quantity exactly as filed
architectural_notes: Lives at the API boundary (app/routes/, renders_via react): the operator files via an HTTP POST that returns JSON, and read-back is a GET. The boundary validates the payload and delegates persistence to the Stock service (app/services/), which calls the Stock repository (app/repositories/) as the sole ORM-touching layer writing a Stock model (app/models/stock.py); the (sku, location, quantity) NOT NULL guarantees (PI3) back the exact read-back. Cross-cutting concern: input validation is OWNED AT THIS BOUNDARY (NFR-F1-validation-messages) — an invalid file (negative quantity, missing required field) must be rejected before any DB write with an HTTP error body that NAMES the offending field, not a generic 'bad request'. This boundary field-named-error behavior requires its own real-branch behavior/fitness test (POST invalid payload to the endpoint, assert the response body identifies the field), distinct from the service-layer validation-before-write check.
